name: video-player
title: Video Player
description: A framed video player with the same grouped custom transport controls as Audio Player — a poster, no autoplay, a "can't play" card with Download, and onSourceExpired to renew an expired signed URL.

meta.whenToUse: A single video asset that needs a branded frame plus grouped skip controls, mute, and keyboard shortcuts.
meta.whenNotToUse: Playlists, caption editing, fullscreen-first viewing, or adaptive streaming control surfaces.
